crombolo jobs list

The site's and its bundles' background jobs, newest first: what each is, its state and how far it got. Changes nothing.

crombolo jobs list [--state <state>] [--owner <owner>] [--limit <limit>] [--offset <offset>] [--fields <fields>] [--profile <profile>] [--env <env>]
ArgumentWhat it is
--stateOnly the jobs in this state. One of waiting, running, failed, done.
--ownerOnly one bundle's jobs, or site for the site's own.
--limitHow many to list. Default 50.
--offsetHow many to skip first. Default 0.
--fieldsOnly these fields of each item, comma-separated.
--profileAct on the site this profile names, rather than this one.
--envA hosted site's environment.

crombolo jobs retry

Run a failed background job again, from its first attempt. Each run acts again.

crombolo jobs retry <id> [--profile <profile>] [--env <env>]
ArgumentWhat it is
idIts id, or at least the first 8 characters of it. Required.
--profileAct on the site this profile names, rather than this one.
--envA hosted site's environment.

crombolo jobs show

One background job: what it is, how far it got, and why it failed. Changes nothing.

crombolo jobs show <id> [--profile <profile>] [--env <env>]
ArgumentWhat it is
idIts id, or at least the first 8 characters of it. Required.
--profileAct on the site this profile names, rather than this one.
--envA hosted site's environment.
